newsitem.title: LATVIA: MERITA 2-YR LAT BOND HAS S&P BBB+ RATING.
newsitem.headline: MERITA 2-YR LAT BOND HAS S&P BBB+ RATING.

text.p: Finnish Merita Bank's lat-denominated two-year bond issue has a Standad & Poors BBB+ rating, the Latvian central depository said on Thursday.

"The depository on Monday registered the first issue of a foreign company's shares, which was Merita Bank's closed bond issue with a coupon of 9.0 percent," Martinsh Rikshis, depository president, told a news conference.
"It has Standard & Poors rating of BBB+," he added.
The Merita issue is worth 15 million lats and the first auction on April 9 saw 650,000 lats of bonds sold.
Merita has made other Baltic issues and has already tapped the Estonian kroon market twice.
The Latvian issue was lead managed by Hansabank-Latvija, part of Estonia's largest bank Hansapank .
